name: Vidby
summary: Vidby is an AI-powered video translation and voiceover tool, supporting 70+ languages for fast and accurate video localization.
description:
Vidby is an AI-powered video translation and voiceover tool, supporting 70+ languages for fast and accurate video localization.

Try vidby now and expand your business to international markets. Translate and dub videos with up to 100% accuracy in 70+ languages using AI.

AI voiceover: Quickly add multi-language narration to your videos, making them accessible worldwide. Fast translation: Localize videos in over 70 languages with just a few clicks, no manual work needed. Subtitle generation: Automatic, editable subtitles for every video, enhancing SEO and accessibility. Speaker detection: Accurately identifies and translates multiple speakers in one video.

howToUse.title: Register and Log In
howToUse.description: Go to Vidby, sign up for a free or premium account, and log into your dashboard.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Video
howToUse.description: Click on 'Upload Video' and select your file. Supported formats include MP4, MOV, AVI, and more.

howToUse.title: Select Languages and Voices
howToUse.description: Pick the target language(s) for translation. Choose from a variety of voices for narration or dubbing.

howToUse.title: Configure Subtitles and Speaker Detection
howToUse.description: Enable automatic subtitle generation and confirm speaker identification for multi-speaker videos.

howToUse.title: Initiate AI Translation and Voiceover
howToUse.description: Start the process. Vidby’s AI will translate, dub, and subtitle your video. Wait for processing (time depends on video length).

howToUse.title: Review and Edit Output
howToUse.description: Check the translated video, subtitles, and voiceover for accuracy. Edit any section if needed.

howToUse.title: Export or Share
howToUse.description: Export your localized video, subtitles, and transcripts. Share directly via Vidby links or download for distribution.
